meta.title: API Search & Chat Latency Breakdown
meta.subtitle: Breakdown of execution time across ChromaDB vector retrieval, embedding calculation, and local Ollama Gemma 4:e4b inference.

spans.name: POST /chat (End-to-End RAG Cycle)
spans.detail: Complete request lifecycle from client submission to final grounded response.

spans.name: Payload Validation & Sanitization
spans.detail: Validate JSON body, question length, and conversation history structure.

spans.name: Question Embedding (all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
spans.detail: Calculate 384-dimensional dense vector representation via PyTorch MPS.

spans.name: ChromaDB Vector ANN Query
spans.detail: Search local SQLite metadata catalog and HNSW index for top-k nearest cosine neighbors.

spans.name: Relevance Filtering & Deduplication
spans.detail: Filter chunks failing the similarity threshold and rank by page relevance.

spans.name: Grounding Prompt Synthesis
spans.detail: Format system instructions, conversation context, and [S1..Sn] grounding blocks.

spans.name: Ollama TTFT (Gemma 4:e4b Warmup)
spans.detail: Forward prompt tokens into Ollama HTTP API and receive first generated token.

spans.name: Autoregressive LLM Generation
spans.detail: Stream full answer tokens at ~38 tokens/second utilizing Apple Silicon GPU cores.

spans.name: Citation Regex & Confidence Scoring
spans.detail: Extract [S1] markers, link back to chunk metadata, and assess answer confidence.

spans.name: Response Packaging & Transmission
spans.detail: Serialize Pydantic response schema and flush HTTP 200 payload to client.

cards.title: ChromaDB Retrieval (120ms / 8.3%)
items: Embedded SQLite metadata query + HNSW vector index lookups execute in 120ms.
Zero network hop because ChromaDB runs in-process in the backend container.

cards.title: Ollama Inference (1125ms / 77.6%)
items: Gemma 4:e4b generation dominates total endpoint latency.
TTFT is 185ms, followed by sustained 38 tok/s generation on Mac unified memory.

cards.title: Pipeline Overhead (205ms / 14.1%)
items: Includes 384-dim embedding generation (65ms), prompt preparation, and citation verification.
Optimized to minimize CPU-to-GPU memory copies during request handling.
